verdict.rationale: The webhooks docs cover both halves of the story. Every webhook carries a `webhook-id` header that ComplyAdvantage tells you to use as an idempotency key for deduplication, and webhook signing is available to verify authenticity, though it is opt-in per account. The evidence shows these features exist but gives little detail on how they work. Missing for 10: the signature algorithm and verification procedure, timestamp/replay protection, explicit retry-schedule documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
